reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here tells me the fixtures are UL listed or that my electrician will be happy hanging one. I'd probably save the cloud pendant to a Pinterest board and move on, since I walked out of a showroom last weekend without buying anyway.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? Nothing here says so, and I don't want to wire up an unknown brand's fixture and then find out it's not certified.
would_change_my_mind: Visible UL/ETL listing on the product page, clear install specs, real customer photos and reviews of installed pieces, and a returns policy that doesn't make me pay shipping on a large fragile pendant.
